info.title: ApexPost Logistics API
info.description: RESTful API for ApexPost Logistics shipment tracking and management (v2)

get.summary: Get shipment by tracking number (partner API key required)
Get paged list of shipments with optional filtering (v2)
Get a single shipment by tracking number (v2)

delete.summary: Delete a shipment - only while status is Created (v2, Admin only)

get.summary: Get scan history for a shipment (v2)

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number in the format APX-XXXXXXXX (8 digits).

recipientPhone.description: Recipient phone number in a valid international format.

price.description: Shipping price in the local currency (non-negative).

CreateShipmentRequest.description: Request body for creating a new shipment.

scanType.description: Type of scan event (Pickup, InTransit, Delivered, Failed).

location.description: Free-text location where the scan was taken.

scannedAtUtc.description: UTC time the scan was captured.

LatestScanDto.description: Summary of the most recent scan on a shipment.

trackingReference.description: Tracking reference in the format APX-XXXXXXXX.

createdAtUtc.description: UTC time the shipment was created.

PartnerShipmentResponse.description: Minimal read-only shipment view returned to partners via the X-Api-Key endpoint.

RecipientDto.description: Recipient details grouped for the v2 response contract.

ScanRejectionDto.description: Reason a single scan was rejected during bulk upload.

ScanType.description: Kind of scan event recorded by a courier.

scans.description: Scans to upload; each carries its client-generated ID for idempotent de-duplication.

ScanUploadRequest.description: Request body for bulk upload of offline-collected shipment scans.

duplicatesSkipped.description: Number of scans skipped because their ID was already stored.

rejected.description: Number of scans rejected by validation.

rejections.description: Per-scan rejection reasons (scan ID plus reason code).

ScanUploadResponse.description: Response body for a bulk scan upload: counts of accepted, de-duplicated and rejected scans.

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number in the format APX-XXXXXXXX.

price.description: Shipping price in the local currency.

oneOf.description: Most recent scan event, or null when the shipment has no scans yet.

createdAtUtc.description: UTC time the shipment was created.

ShipmentResponseV2.description:
v2 shipment response with recipient details grouped into an object and the
most recent scan included for timeline display.

id.description: Client-generated scan ID; re-uploads of the same ID are de-duplicated.

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number the scan belongs to; must match the route.

courierId.description: Courier who performed the scan; must match the caller's courierId claim.

location.description: Free-text location where the scan was taken.

scannedAtUtc.description: UTC time the scan was captured on the device.

notes.description: Optional notes; required for Delivered scans (recipient signature).

ShipmentScanDto.description: A single offline scan uploaded for a shipment.

id.description: Unique scan identifier (client-generated, used for de-duplication).

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number the scan belongs to.

scanType.description: Type of scan event (Pickup, InTransit, Delivered, Failed).

location.description: Free-text location where the scan was taken.

scannedAtUtc.description: UTC time the scan was captured.

notes.description: Optional notes (recipient signature for Delivered scans).

ShipmentScanResponse.description: v1 scan response for a single recorded scan event.

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number; must match the tracking number in the route.

price.description: Shipping price in the local currency (non-negative).

recipientPhone.description: Recipient phone number in a valid international format.

UpdateShipmentRequest.description: Request body for replacing the editable details of an existing shipment.

status.description: Target status; must be a known shipment status and a valid transition.

UpdateStatusRequest.description: Request body for changing only the status of a shipment.

Bearer.description: JWT Bearer token issued for couriers and admins
